description: Iteration 2 summary figure: selection by site class, gnomAD LoF spectrum, constraint, expression
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT="/agent/jobs/ad7edfe9-b6a6-4270-b5cb-6f473ffd667f/provenance"
L=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/ALLC_gnomad_lof.csv")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13.5,9))

# A: dN/dS by site class, primates vs non-primates (values computed this iteration)
a=ax[0,0]
classes=["pocket","hexamer interface\n(non-patch)","exposure-matched\ncontrol","whole protein"]
prim=[0.073,0.421,0.194,0.218]; nonp=[0.035,0.331,0.138,0.140]
x=np.arange(4); w=0.38
a.bar(x-w/2, nonp, w, label="non-primate mammals (62 pairs)", color="#1d3557")
a.bar(x+w/2, prim, w, label="primates (22 pairs)", color="#e07a5f")
a.set_xticks(x); a.set_xticklabels(classes, fontsize=8); a.set_ylabel("pooled dN/dS vs human")
a.legend(fontsize=8); a.set_title("Pocket is constrained, the oligomer interface is not", fontsize=10)
for i,(v1,v2) in enumerate(zip(nonp,prim)):
    a.text(i-w/2, v1+.008, f"{v1:.3f}", ha="center", fontsize=7); a.text(i+w/2, v2+.008, f"{v2:.3f}", ha="center", fontsize=7)

# B: gnomAD pLoF allele frequencies
b=ax[0,1]
Lh=L[L.lof=="HC"].dropna(subset=["af"]).sort_values("af",ascending=False).head(25)
cols=["#c1121f" if h>0 else "#8d99ae" for h in Lh.hom]
b.barh(range(len(Lh)), Lh.af, color=cols)
b.set_yticks(range(len(Lh))); b.set_yticklabels([str(s)[:22] for s in Lh.hgvsp.fillna(Lh.variant)], fontsize=6)
b.invert_yaxis(); b.set_xscale("log"); b.set_xlabel("gnomAD v4 allele frequency")
b.set_title("High-confidence LoF variants in human ALLC\n(red = homozygotes observed)", fontsize=10)

# C: gnomAD LoF constraint comparison
c=ax[1,0]
genes=["ALLC","URAD","HPRT1","PGK1"]
oe=[0.889,0.866,0.210,0.111]; lo=[0.691,0.426,0.104,0.051]; hi=[1.157,1.981,0.481,0.288]
c.errorbar(oe, range(4), xerr=[np.array(oe)-np.array(lo), np.array(hi)-np.array(oe)], fmt="o", color="#1d3557", capsize=4)
c.axvline(1.0, ls="--", c="grey"); c.set_yticks(range(4)); c.set_yticklabels(genes)
c.set_xlabel("gnomAD observed/expected LoF (90% CI)")
c.set_title("Human population constraint: ALLC is LoF-tolerant", fontsize=10)

# D: expression
d=ax[1,1]
d.axis("off")
d.text(0.02,0.92,"Human ALLC expression and protein evidence", fontsize=11, weight="bold", transform=d.transAxes)
txt=("Human Protein Atlas (ENSG00000151360):\n"
     "  RNA tissue specificity: tissue enriched, detected in a single tissue\n"
     "  RNA tissue specific nTPM: testis 15.6\n"
     "  Single-cell: early spermatids 155.0 nCPM, late primary spermatocytes 95.9 nCPM\n"
     "  HPA protein evidence: evidence at transcript level\n\n"
     "UniProt Q8N6M5: PE = 1, keyword 'Proteomics identification'\n"
     "  cross-references: PeptideAtlas, MassIVE, ProteomicsDB, PaxDb\n"
     "  no antibody or targeted protein study among its 6 references\n\n"
     "gnomAD v4: 128 pLoF-class variants, 40 observed vs 45.0 expected LoF\n"
     "  p.Trp161Ter AF 1.1e-3 with 2 homozygotes; p.Arg89Ter 1 homozygote;\n"
     "  p.Glu194AsnfsTer5 2 homozygotes; p.Trp234Ter (invariant pocket residue) present")
d.text(0.02,0.08,txt, fontsize=8.5, family="monospace", transform=d.transAxes, va="bottom")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
